name: The World-Eater
description: The corpse of a reality-bending titan embedded in the core of Uthros behind the doors, which the Illvoi seem to be trying to turn into a weapon; its pull overwhelms Geldan.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Geldan sees the corpse of a titan embedded in the core and falls to her knees before it.

timeline.summary: Geldan surrenders to the titan's pull, resolving to let it remake her.
